id: 09_Measurement of Single Phase Power Power Factor Voltage Current of CFL LED Fluore
title: 电工实验：测灯具的功率与功率因数（国内版）
source_doc: course/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/09_Measurement of Single Phase Power Power Factor Voltage Current of CFL LED Fluore.md
author_source: project/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/09_Measurement of Single Phase Power Power Factor Voltage Current of CFL LED Fluore（国内版）/src.py

points.K1: 实验目的：四种灯的电流功率
points.K3: 按功率因数高低选功率表

points.K11: 电流回路粗线，电压回路细线
points.K13: 读数不歪看，量程对刻度
points.S1: 含汞灯管：破碎处理与回收
points.S3: 仪表看合格标识，故障挂牌停用

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台前，台上并排放着四盏不同的灯
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of an electrical lab bench with four different lamps in a row, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天做电工实验：给四种灯测功率！
overlay: 电工实验：测灯具的功率与功率因数

shots.scene: 白炽灯、荧光灯管、节能灯、LED 灯四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: an incandescent bulb, a straight fluorescent tube, a spiral compact fluorescent bulb and an LED bulb. No people.
shots.narration: 看看哪种灯最费电，哪种最省电。

shots.scene: 阿杰在宿舍台灯前犹豫，手里拿着两只不同的灯泡
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands by a desk lamp in a dormitory, holding two different light bulbs and looking unsure.
shots.narration: 阿杰想换台灯灯泡，不知道选哪种。

shots.scene: 小研笑着指向实验室里的灯具实验台
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student smiles and points toward a lab bench with several lamps and meters.
shots.narration: 小研说：做个实验，用数据说话。

shots.section_title: 实验目的：四种灯的电流功率
shots.scene: 王老师站在实验台旁，四盏灯各连着电表
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator stands beside a bench where four lamps are each connected to analog meters with blank dials.
shots.narration: 本实验要测四种灯的电流和电压。
overlay: 实验目的：四种灯的电流功率

shots.section_title: 实验目的：四种灯的电流功率
shots.scene: 电流、电压、功率、功率因数四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four simple icons: a current arrow, a voltage symbol, a power meter dial and a triangle diagram. No people.
shots.narration: 还要测功率，算出功率因数。

shots.scene: 器材柜里取出电流表、电压表、功率表
shots.prompt_en: An open equipment cabinet with an AC ammeter, an AC voltmeter and a wattmeter, all with blank dials. No people.
shots.narration: 准备交流电流表、电压表和功率表。

shots.scene: 数字万用表图标代替电压表，旁边打勾
shots.prompt_en: A digital multimeter icon with a blank display placed beside a voltmeter icon, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 没有电压表，可以用万用表代替。

shots.scene: 四盏灯和一捆连接导线摆在台面上
shots.prompt_en: Four lamps and a bundle of connecting wires laid out on a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 再备好四种灯和足够的连接导线。

shots.section_title: 按功率因数高低选功率表
shots.scene: 两只外观相同的功率表，一只贴蓝色标签一只贴橙色标签
shots.prompt_en: Two similar wattmeters with blank dials, one with a blue blank label and one with an orange blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 功率表有两种，要按灯来选。
overlay: 按功率因数高低选功率表

shots.section_title: 按功率因数高低选功率表
shots.scene: LED 灯和节能灯图标连向低功率因数功率表
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an LED bulb and a spiral compact fluorescent bulb connected by arrows to the wattmeter with the orange label. No people.
shots.narration: LED和节能灯功率因数低，用低功率因数表。

shots.section_title: 按功率因数高低选功率表
shots.scene: 白炽灯图标连向高功率因数功率表
shots.prompt_en: An incandescent bulb icon connected by an arrow to the wattmeter with the blue label. No people.
shots.narration: 白炽灯功率因数接近一，用另一种表。

shots.scene: 小研用万用表两支表笔碰一根未接入电路的导线两端
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student touches the two probes of a multimeter to both ends of an unconnected wire on the bench.
shots.narration: 导线用前，先用万用表测通断。

shots.scene: 断线图标打叉，通的导线打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a wire broken inside with a red X, and an intact wire with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 内部断了的线，挑出来不用。

shots.scene: 简化电路图：电源、开关、电流表、功率表、灯
shots.prompt_en: A simple circuit diagram icon: an AC source, a switch, an ammeter, a wattmeter and a lamp in a loop, with a voltmeter across the lamp. No people.
shots.narration: 接线前，先把电路图看懂。

shots.scene: 箭头从电源出发，依次经过开关、电流表、功率表到灯
shots.prompt_en: An arrow travels from the AC source through the switch, the ammeter and the wattmeter to the lamp. No people.
shots.narration: 电源经开关，串过电流表和功率表。

shots.scene: 电压表图标并在灯的两端
shots.prompt_en: A voltmeter icon connected across the two ends of a lamp icon. No people.
shots.narration: 电压表并在灯两端，测灯的电压。

shots.scene: 功率表放大图，四个接线柱旁各有一个空白小牌
shots.prompt_en: A close-up icon of a wattmeter with four terminals, each marked by a small blank tag. No people.
shots.narration: 功率表有四个接线端。

shots.scene: 电流线圈串在回路里，电压线圈跨在负载上
shots.prompt_en: An icon showing a thick current coil placed in series in the loop and a thin voltage coil connected across the load. No people.
shots.narration: 电流线圈串进回路，电压线圈跨在负载上。

shots.scene: 老周在空白白板前画分数线，只有符号没有文字
shots.prompt_en: The older man stands at a blank whiteboard drawing a fraction line with simple symbols, no words.
shots.narration: 用功率表前，先算功率表常数。

shots.scene: 表盘指针指在一格刻度上，旁边一个乘号和数字 2
shots.prompt_en: A wattmeter dial icon with the needle on a mark, next to a multiplication sign and the number 2. No people.
shots.narration: 读数乘常数，才是真实功率。

shots.scene: 欣欣竖起手指提醒
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises one finger as a reminder.
shots.narration: 换了量程，常数也要重新算。

shots.scene: 一张空白记录表，四行四种灯的图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank data table with four rows, each row starting with a lamp icon, and empty columns. No people.
shots.narration: 每种灯的电压、电流、功率都记下来。

shots.scene: 功率除以电压乘电流的图示
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram: a power icon divided by a voltage icon multiplied by a current icon. No people.
shots.narration: 功率因数等于功率除以电压乘电流。

shots.scene: 有功功率与视在功率两根长短不同的柱
shots.prompt_en: Two bars side by side, a shorter one for real power and a taller one for apparent power. No people.
shots.narration: 就是有功功率和视在功率之比。

shots.scene: 刻度尺最高处标着 1
shots.prompt_en: A vertical scale with its top mark highlighted as 1. No people.
shots.narration: 功率因数最大就是一。

shots.scene: 实验台全景，灯和表旁各插一面编号小旗
shots.prompt_en: A wide view of the lab bench with four lamps and three meters, each with a small numbered flag from 1 to 7. No people.
shots.narration: 先认清台上的四盏灯和三块表。

shots.section_title: 万用表拨到交流电压档
shots.scene: 手把万用表旋钮拨到交流电压档，屏幕空白
shots.prompt_en: A hand turns a multimeter dial to the AC voltage position marked with a wave symbol; the display is blank.
shots.narration: 万用表当电压表，先拨到交流电压档。
overlay: 万用表拨到交流电压档

shots.section_title: 万用表拨到交流电压档
shots.scene: 旋钮指在电流档或直流档的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a multimeter dial set to the current position and to the DC position, both crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 档位拨错，读数不对还会损坏表。

shots.section_title: 电流回路粗线，电压回路细线
shots.scene: 一粗一细两根导线并排
shots.prompt_en: A thick connecting wire and a thin connecting wire side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 电流回路用粗线，电压回路用细线。
overlay: 电流回路粗线，电压回路细线

shots.scene: 阿杰对照电路图接好线，电源开关处于断开位置
shots.prompt_en: The young male student finishes connecting the wires according to a blank circuit diagram, with the bench power switch in the off position.
shots.narration: 按图接好线，选好要测的那盏灯。

shots.scene: 王老师检查后点头，阿杰合上电源，白炽灯亮起
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks the wiring and nods; the young male student switches on the power and the incandescent bulb lights up.
shots.narration: 检查无误，合上电源，灯亮了。

shots.scene: 小研依次看电压表、功率表、电流表，并在空白表格上记录
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads the voltmeter, the wattmeter and the ammeter in turn and writes on a blank data sheet.
shots.narration: 依次读电压、功率、电流，记进表格。

shots.scene: 阿杰拉下电源开关，灯熄灭
shots.prompt_en: The young male student switches off the bench power and the bulb goes dark.
shots.narration: 读完就断电，再换下一盏灯。

shots.section_title: 读数不歪看，量程对刻度
shots.scene: 侧面歪着看表盘的眼睛图标打叉，正对表盘的打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: an eye looking at a meter dial from the side with a red X, and an eye looking straight at it with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 读指针表要正对表盘，避免视差。
overlay: 读数不歪看，量程对刻度

shots.section_title: 读数不歪看，量程对刻度
shots.scene: 表盘上下两排刻度，箭头分别连到两个量程旋钮
shots.prompt_en: A meter dial with two rows of scale marks, arrows linking each row to a different range setting. No people.
shots.narration: 选哪个量程，就读哪排刻度。

shots.scene: LED 灯亮起，旁边接的是低功率因数功率表
shots.prompt_en: An LED bulb is lit on the bench, connected to the wattmeter with the orange label.
shots.narration: 测LED灯，换上低功率因数功率表。

shots.scene: 电流表指针只偏转一点点
shots.prompt_en: An ammeter dial with the needle moved only slightly from zero. No people.
shots.narration: LED的电流很小，读数要仔细。

shots.scene: 节能灯亮起，小研记录读数
shots.prompt_en: A spiral compact fluorescent bulb is lit; the female graduate student records readings on a blank sheet.
shots.narration: 节能灯同样步骤，读完断电。

shots.scene: 电源引线两根，一根挂相线小牌，一根挂零线小牌
shots.prompt_en: Two supply leads coming from a wall socket panel, one with a blank phase tag and one with a blank neutral tag. No people.
shots.narration: 电源两根线，先分清相线和零线。

shots.scene: 老李指着实验台上的颜色标识说明
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer points at a color legend chart with blank color swatches on the bench and explains.
shots.narration: 按本实验室的颜色标识来认线。

shots.scene: 四盏灯下方柱形：白炽灯最高，LED 最低
shots.prompt_en: Four lamp icons with bars beneath them: the incandescent bar is tallest and the LED bar is shortest. No people.
shots.narration: 结果：白炽灯最费电，LED最省电。

shots.scene: 白炽灯冒出热浪图标，只有少量光线
shots.prompt_en: An incandescent bulb icon radiating large heat waves and only a few light rays. No people.
shots.narration: 白炽灯的电能大多变成了热。

shots.scene: 阿杰在宿舍台灯里装上 LED 灯泡，满意地笑
shots.prompt_en: The young male student screws an LED bulb into his desk lamp in the dormitory and smiles.
shots.narration: 阿杰决定：台灯换成LED灯。

shots.scene: 一本空白封面的电工教材和一只举起的手
shots.prompt_en: A textbook with a blank cover next to a raised hand icon. No people.
shots.narration: 课后对照教材复习，有疑问就问。

shots.section_title: 含汞灯管：破碎处理与回收
shots.scene: 荧光灯管和节能灯图标旁有一个小水银滴图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fluorescent tube and a spiral compact fluorescent bulb with a small mercury droplet symbol beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 荧光灯和节能灯里含汞，又易碎。
overlay: 含汞灯管：破碎处理与回收

shots.section_title: 含汞灯管：破碎处理与回收
shots.scene: 灯管碎了，小研拉下开关并打开窗户
shots.prompt_en: A fluorescent tube lies broken on the bench; the female graduate student switches off the power and opens a window.
shots.narration: 灯管碎了，先断电、开窗通风。

shots.section_title: 含汞灯管：破碎处理与回收
shots.scene: 徒手捡碎玻璃的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bare hand picking up broken glass pieces, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要徒手捡，戴手套用工具收起。

shots.section_title: 含汞灯管：破碎处理与回收
shots.scene: 戴手套的小研把碎片装进密封袋，交给王老师
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wearing gloves seals the broken pieces in a bag and hands it to the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 碎片和废灯管按学校规定回收。

shots.scene: 金属灯架和金属外壳仪表，外壳上连一根黄绿双色线
shots.prompt_en: A metal lamp fixture and a metal-cased meter, each with a green-yellow striped earth wire attached to its casing. No people.
shots.narration: 金属外壳的灯具和仪器要接保护地。

shots.scene: 三芯插头打勾，掰掉接地脚的插头打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a three-pin plug with a green check, and a plug with its earth pin broken off, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 用三芯插头，不能去掉接地脚。

shots.scene: 老李查看实验台后面的接地端子
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer inspects the earth terminal at the back of a lab bench with a flashlight.
shots.narration: 接地线松了断了，报告老师维修。

shots.section_title: 仪表看合格标识，故障挂牌停用
shots.scene: 仪表侧面贴着绿色空白合格标签
shots.prompt_en: A meter with a green blank inspection label on its side. No people.
shots.narration: 仪表要有有效的检定或校验标识。
overlay: 仪表看合格标识，故障挂牌停用

shots.section_title: 仪表看合格标识，故障挂牌停用
shots.scene: 指针卡住、外壳裂开的电表挂上红色空白停用牌
shots.prompt_en: A meter with a stuck needle and a cracked case, hung with a red blank out-of-service tag. No people.
shots.narration: 指针卡滞、外壳破损，挂牌停用。

shots.section_title: 仪表看合格标识，故障挂牌停用
shots.scene: 阿杰把坏表交给王老师登记
shots.prompt_en: The young male student hands a faulty meter to the safety administrator, who writes in a blank logbook.
shots.narration: 坏表交老师登记，不自己拆修。

shots.scene: 实验台配电箱里的漏电保护器，手指按下试验按钮
shots.prompt_en: A finger presses the test button on a residual current circuit breaker inside a lab bench distribution box.
shots.narration: 实验台电源装有漏电保护器。

shots.scene: 按下按钮后开关跳开，旁边打勾
shots.prompt_en: After the test button is pressed, the breaker lever drops to the off position, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 按试验按钮能跳闸，说明它有效。

shots.scene: 按了不跳闸的保护器挂上停用牌，老李记录
shots.prompt_en: A breaker that did not trip is hung with a red blank tag while the facility engineer records it on a blank form.
shots.narration: 不跳闸就停用报修，按学校规定定期试。

shots.scene: 四盏灯和功率表图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of four lamps and a wattmeter with a blank dial. No people.
shots.narration: 按灯选功率表，读数乘常数。

shots.scene: 记录表和柱状图图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blank data table and a bar chart. No people.
shots.narration: 算出功率因数，LED最省电。

shots.scene: 密封袋、接地线、合格标签、漏电保护器四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons with green checks: a sealed bag, a green-yellow earth wire, a green inspection label and a residual current breaker. No people.
shots.narration: 破管回收，外壳接地，表要合格。

shots.scene: 欣欣在断电整理好的实验台前挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye in front of a tidy, switched-off lab bench with four lamps.
shots.narration: 省电又安全，下个实验见！
